fields.System.Title: INV-1 — Stock balances
fields.System.Description:
Purpose

Answer "how much of what is where" for every question the warehouse asks — by location, by
product, by batch, and by status.

Scope

In. Balance queries by location, product, warehouse, and batch.

Out. Changing balances — that is [INV-3](INV-3-moving-stock.md). Fast aggregate
availability — that is [INV-9](INV-9-availability-projection.md).

Design notes

The balance key is (product, location, batch, status). Batch is null for untracked
products. Four rows can exist for the same product in the same location if it holds two batches
in two statuses — and that is correct, not a modelling error.

Never store qty_available as an independent column. Two numbers that must agree will
eventually disagree. Compute it, or use a database-maintained generated column.

"How much stock is there" is an ambiguous question. Sales means available, the floor means
on hand, finance means on hand plus in-transit. Name the fields precisely and never let a field
called quantity exist on its own.

Risks

| Risk | Reference |
|---|---|
| Available stored separately and drifting from on-hand minus reserved | [doc 04 §3.3](../../../docs/04-modules.md) |
| Query missing the batch dimension for tracked products | [doc 03 §3](../../../docs/03-master-data.md) |
